2607.27303.title: THGFM: Dual-Branch Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Fusion Model
2607.27303.paper_summary: Temporal heterogeneous graphs offer a natural abstraction for dynamic relational systems in which diverse node and relation types co-exist and evolve over time. Learning on such graphs requires jointly modeling cross-type structural heterogeneity and the temporal dynamics of interactions, yet existing methods still struggle to reconcile parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with relation-aware specialization, and typically inject time only as additive features outside the attention kernel. We propose \textbf{THGFM}, a web-scale temporal heterogeneous graph fusion model that addresses both limitations within a unified dual-path architecture. THGFM couples a \textit{Shared-Space Temporal Attention} branch for parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with a \textit{Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention} branch for relation-aware specialization, and integrates them through \textit{Dual-Path Relational--Shared Fusion}, instantiated with \textit{Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion}: a adaptive mechanism that assigns independent, type-conditioned feature-wise gates to the shared and specialized branches, allowing both to be amplified or suppressed without zero-sum competition. To directly incorporate relative time into the attention score, THGFM further introduces \textit{Rotary Temporal Attention}, which rotates queries and keys by half-phases of relative time before matching. THGFM consistently outperforms baseline graph transformer models on academic graphs benchmarks, delivering a $+3.25\%$ six-task mean gain, with peak relative gains of $+12.37\%$ on OAG-CS PV, $+4.87\%$ on PF-$L_2$, and $+1.18\%$ on PF-$L_1$, and $+4.24\%$, $+3.73\%$, and $+4.61\%$ on OGBN-MAG, HTAG-ArXiv, and HTAG-DBLP, respectively.
2607.27303.paper_summary_zh: 時間異質圖提供了一種自然的抽象，用於動態關係系統，其中各種節點和關係類型共存並隨時間演變。在這樣的圖上進行學習需要共同建模跨類型結構異質性和交互的時間動態，但現有的方法仍然難以調和參數高效的跨類型轉移與關係感知的專門化，通常僅將時間作為注意力核心外的附加特徵注入。我們提出了\textbf{THGFM}，一種網絡規模的時間異質圖融合模型，旨在通過統一的雙路徑架構解決這兩個限制。THGFM結合了一個\textit{共享空間時間注意力}分支，以實現參數高效的跨類型轉移，以及一個\textit{關係類型分區時間注意力}分支，以實現關係感知的專門化，並通過\textit{雙路徑關係--共享融合}將它們整合在一起，這是通過\textit{類型條件非競爭門控加和融合}實現的：一種自適應機制，為共享和專門化分支分配獨立的、類型條件的特徵門，允許兩者在不進行零和競爭的情況下被放大或抑制。為了將相對時間直接納入注意力分數，THGFM進一步引入了\textit{旋轉時間注意力}，在匹配之前將查詢和鍵旋轉相對時間的半個相位。THGFM在學術圖基準上始終超越基線圖Transformer模型，實現了$+3.25\%$的六任務平均增益，在OAG-CS PV上達到$+12.37\%$的峰值相對增益，在PF-$L_2$上達到$+4.87\%$，在PF-$L_1$上達到$+1.18\%$，以及在OGBN-MAG、HTAG-ArXiv和HTAG-DBLP上分別達到$+4.24\%$、$+3.73\%$和$+4.61\%$。
